'''Percival Vale''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Vale was the son of a rich [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owner on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. In about [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Vale was sent by his father to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where his father intended for him to enroll at the [[Almas Academy]] and train to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. However, Vale instead entered a relationship with [[Selima DeWitt]] and along with the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Higgie Sethven]], they established the shop [[Natural]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. About a year after his arrival in the system, Natural became the site of a battle between two security teams, sent by the rival companies [[Culpharm]] and [[Genasys]]. While Sethven and DeWitt sheltered upstairs in the shop, Vale waited on the ground floor with a stick, in an attempt to defend them. However, all three were eventually rescued by the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. A few weeks later, Vale and DeWitt became engaged.
